summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: ChatGPT and Gemini are fighting to be the AI bot that sells you stuff
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware's New Era: Moving at AI Speed
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
